name: Ubicual
author: Ubicual

sections.description:
Connect your site to Ubicual, the email and SMS marketing platform.

  • Signup forms: show the form of a Ubicual capture with the “Captura de Ubicual” widget or the [ubicual] shortcode (in block themes, with the Shortcode block). Submissions are saved to the capture’s lists.
  • User registrations: people who register on your site and tick the consent checkbox join the lists of the chosen capture. Start an automation with the “Se registra en tu WordPress” (registers on your WordPress) trigger.
  • WooCommerce orders: every paid order reaches Ubicual with its total and products, so you can start automations with the “Hace un pedido en WooCommerce” (places a WooCommerce order) trigger: thank-you emails, review requests, cross-selling… The consent checkbox is shown in both the classic and the block checkout. Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Nobody is subscribed without ticking the checkbox: registrations and orders of people who do not tick it only count when they already are Ubicual contacts.

You need a Ubicual account and its API token. The plugin interface is in Spanish.

External services

This plugin relies on the Ubicual services to work:

  • landing.ubicual.com: when the settings or the widget are saved, and when a form is displayed (cached for 10 minutes), the plugin sends the account’s API token to get its captures and the form fields.
  • subscribers.ubicual.com: when a visitor submits a signup form, their browser sends the form data (name, email, phone or the other fields of the capture). If registrations or orders are enabled in Settings > Ubicual, when a user registers or an order is paid the plugin sends the email, name, phone, whether the consent checkbox was ticked, the IP address and browser and, for orders, the order number, total, currency and products.

Terms of use and privacy policy: https://www.kinetica.mobi/aviso-legal-y-politicas-de-privacidad/
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New and activate it.
  2. In Ubicual, create a capture in Landing pages > Captura WordPress and copy your API token.
  3. Form: add the “Captura de Ubicual” widget in Appearance > Widgets, or the [ubicual] shortcode to any page.
  4. Registrations and orders: in Settings > Ubicual, paste the token, choose the capture and enable what you want to send.
sections.faq:
Which options does the shortcode have?

[ubicual captura=”123″ boton=”Subscribe” etiquetas=”0″ clase=”my-class”]. Without captura, it shows the capture chosen in Settings > Ubicual.

Are all store customers subscribed?

No. Only those who tick the consent checkbox when registering or checking out. Orders of customers who do not tick it only count when they already are Ubicual contacts.

Does it work with the WooCommerce block checkout?

Yes. Since version 3.0 the consent checkbox is also shown in the block checkout.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Compatible with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.2, including HPOS and the block checkout.
  • Settings > Ubicual: user registrations and WooCommerce orders for automations, with a consent checkbox.
  • [ubicual] shortcode to show the form in block themes.
  • The widget loads the captures without JavaScript, also in the block widget editor.
  • Forms are sent with the capture token; several forms on the same page work independently.
  • Accessible forms with browser validation and inline messages instead of alerts.

2.4

  • JavaScript fixes.

2.3

  • Bug fixes.

2.2

  • Bug fixes.

2.1

  • Compatible with the new ubicual.com.

1.2

  • More form customization options.

1.1.1

  • Screenshots.

1.1

  • Minor style changes.

1.0

  • First version.
